projects.title: Flintstone Real Estate
projects.summary: A brand identity for Flintstone Real Estate, a builder of luxury custom homes. The identity is built around one idea: "Building your vision, stone by stone. Est. 2025"

sections.text: A deep midnight blue and crisp white give the brand a calm, premium feel. Widely spaced, light lettering keeps it modern and luxurious.

sections.heading: On the building site
sections.text: The identity is made for the places clients actually see it: hard hats, site hoarding, signage, vehicles and stationery. Every piece uses the same grid, colours and logo placement.

projects.title: Interface Digital Marketing
projects.summary: he brand identity for Interface Digital Marketing centers around a bold, growth-driven aesthetic inspired by precision geometry and the Golden Ratio, utilizing a striking high-contrast palette of digital red, core black, and pure white paired with clean Montserrat typography. The visual system seamlessly bridges data-driven strategy and creative execution across digital touchpoints, corporate collateral, and large-scale outdoor displays to establish a modern, authoritative market presence.

projects.title: City Medical Center
projects.summary: City Medical Center's brand identity design is a cohesive, modern visual system built around the core themes of continuity, trust, and compassionate care. By translating a multifaceted healthcare model into a clean, approachable, and scalable identity—featuring soothing medical teal tones, clean typography, and empathetic iconography—the branding successfully positions the center as a lifelong partner in health and a leader in modern medical excellence.

projects.title: Midad Jewlry
projects.summary: Midad Jewelry is a Qatari jewelry brand rooted in storytelling, heritage, and emotional resonance.   Each collection is a poetic expression—whether through the romanticism of “Hob Horoof”, the joy of “Bahja”, or the elegance of “Luxury by Midad”. The brand’s essence lies in the phrase:   “A unique story with every piece.” "قصة مميزة مع كل قطعة"   This reflects a commitment to personal meaning, cultural pride, and timeless artistry.

projects.title: Siket Training Center
projects.summary: The SIKET Training Center brand identity employs a modern and professional design to position the institution as a strategic partner in growth. The primary logo creatively forms an abstract "S" with an integrated graduation cap, symbolizing the brand's commitment to transforming ambitious individuals into industry-specific leaders. A cohesive color palette of deep greens and light greens, with occasional yellow accents, projects a reliable yet innovative energy across all applications, including corporate stationery, marketing posters, and digital platforms. Complementing the visual identity is powerful, forward-thinking messaging like "Unlock Your Potential, Master Your Future," ensuring the brand resonates with its audience across physical and online educational environments.
